dos.text: Follow panel-item's own guidance here too, this is the exact same class (PanelItem) and the exact same customElements.define("panel-item", PanelItem) registration, not a separate implementation.
Use badge-type instead of manually inserting a <moz-badge>, same as panel-item, it lazily creates and removes the element for you.

donts.text: Don't go looking for a separate source file or distinct behavior under this name, panel-list.mjs is the only real source for both this id and panel-item.
Don't set submenu after the item has already connected, it's a presence flag read once in connectedCallback, not an observed attribute.
